title: Covariance corollary Cov(f(X),g(X)) ≥ 0 for monotone f, g

problemStatement.plain: Similarly-ordered functions are positively correlated: if $f$ and $g$ both increase, then a uniformly random point makes $f(X)$ and $g(X)$ move together, so their covariance is nonnegative. This is the probabilistic face of the Chebyshev sum/integral inequality proved in the parent.
